1. **Path Flattening & Ring Normalization** ([`src/core/3d/path/flatten.ts`](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/path/flatten.ts)):
   - `flattenPath(path, tolerance, rule)`: Adaptive recursive de Casteljau subdivision ensuring deviation $\le \text{tolerance}$ on quadratics and cubics.

   - `ringOrientation`: Categorizes rings into `"ccw"` vs `"cw"`.
   - `normalizeRings(rings, rule)`: Resolves self-intersections and holes under `"evenodd"` or `"nonzero"` rules, returning `{ outer, holes }[]` with CCW outers and CW holes.

2. **Polygon Offset Engine** ([`src/core/3d/path/offset.ts`](file:///Users/pranav/Project%20Folder/WebAPPBuilder/src/core/3d/path/offset.ts)):
   - `offsetRings` and `offsetPolygon`: Dilates edges into quads and convex corners into arc fans (`"round"`), miter wedges (`"mitre"` with `miterLimit`), or bevel triangles (`"bevel"`), resolving topology with `polygonClipping.union`.
   - Negative delta (inward erosion) computed via complement dilation inside an expanded bounding box, guaranteeing topological robustness and proper hole expansion/elimination.
